IN  THE  HIGH  COURT OF  JUDICATURE  AT  BOMBAY
CRIMINAL  APPELLATE JURISDICTION  
CRIMINAL APPEAL  NO. 248 OF 2025
Hiralal Chintaman Gajare … Appellant
             Versus
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ... Respondents
…………. 
                   
Ms. Rekha Musale, Advocate for the Appellant.
Mr. Kiran C. Shinde, APP for the State. 
              
                CORAM
: SHIVKUMAR DIGE, J.
 DATED : 17   th   MARCH, 2025.  
P.C. : 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP.
2. Considering the allegations made against the appellant, l earned APP seeks
time to take instructions.
3. Considering the submission of learned APP, issue notice to  the respondents
returnable 28.03.2025.
4. Till next date, no steps be taken against the appellant.
( SHIVKUMAR DIGE, J.)
